rationale: Weights mirror the relative emphasis of info.reward_components in the source dataset: tool_use_correctness and content_quality apply to every record and carry the most weight, citation_presence and ethics_redflags are narrower-scope guards (citation only scored for indigenous_and_traditional_knowledge) and carry less. Not yet tuned by the loop -- first candidate for a Tier 4 sweep- lever once Stage 1/2 prove the pipeline works.
